<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks a t‑butyldimethylsilyl (TBS) protecting group and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl. Using the available functional groups, we can search the template catalog for templates that have “t-butyldimethylsilyl” as a broken group and “aliphatic hydroxyls” as a formed group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
